purpose: Prevent source inspection, executed compatibility, and independent reproduction from being reported as equivalent evidence.
w3c_alignment_note: This is a SpatialRuntime evidence-provenance extension motivated by the W3C Agent Conformance and Benchmarking CG reproducibility goal. It is not a W3C reporting-format field and does not imply W3C adoption.
nonclaims: A stronger evidence level does not itself mean a conformance verdict is pass.
A source-review profile is not an executed compatibility score.
Executed evidence is not independently reproduced unless an unrelated reproducer and artifact are recorded.
